Dear Brightwater Health team,

Brightwater's reminder services run on the stack I use every day: I have two years of commercial experience with Node.js and TypeScript. At Tessellate Labs I maintain an invoicing service on PostgreSQL that issues about 9,000 invoices a month.

I understand REST API design and web security. I built role-based access checks for our refund screens, and I built chai-check, which flags insecure form actions.

I don't have healthcare experience. I write the rollback before every migration.

Could we set up a short call?

Best regards,
Rania Haroon

Dear Brightwater Health team,

The billing team at Tessellate is four people and a shared Google Doc called 'things that scared us this week'. Anyone can add to it, and on Fridays we go through it together. The other half of the items turn into tickets before they turn into incidents.

Patient data seems like exactly the place for that habit. I maintain a Node.js and TypeScript invoicing service on PostgreSQL at Tessellate Labs, about 9,000 invoices a month, and built chai-check while working through the PortSwigger Web Security Academy.

Could we set up a short call?

Best regards,
Rania Haroon
